fact: ANEC director-general Matar Ndao says modernisation covers 77% of Senegal's 629 civil registration centres, deployed in Dakar, Thies, Louga, Diourbel, Fatick and Kaolack regions, and maternity units can register births directly in ANEC's system.
ANEC pilot data at 13 July 2026 show 471 of 629 civil registration centres (75%) digitised with the LGEC and 15,352,830 records centralised in the national civil registry (RNEC).

ANEC director-general Matar Ndao says the civil registration management software (LGEC) is deployed in 74% of civil registration centres and the Sama Etat civil online request platform is operational in 189 communes.
ANEC states that 437 of Senegal's 629 civil registration centres are fully deployed on the LGEC, a 70% national deployment rate.
ANEC says it has digitised more than 15.3 million civil registration records, with 67% of centres digitised via the LGEC and 629 centres connected to the national network.
